Earlier this year, Maxon One expanded where and how you can create. Cinema 4D, ZBrush, and the Red Giant plugins for Adobe hosts now run on Windows on Arm (WoA) devices, letting artists work on power-efficient tablets and laptops. Autograph also joined the suite, bringing GPU-accelerated, OpenUSD-based compositing and motion design to the lineup. New creative tools continue to land across the products. Cinema 4D added a modernized UV editor and a Fabric brush for shaping soft materials directly in the viewport, while Redshift introduced a Scratches shader along with High Altitude Clouds to help artists build skies with more depth and atmosphere.

Creators and artists around the world love Maxon One for its all-in-one integration of 3D tools, which simplifies their creative process.

Create and animate characters, objects, and fully realized 3D worlds. Combine rigging, keyframes, procedural animation, and dynamic simulations, then render and composite your final shots in one connected workflow.

Build everything from detailed characters and creatures to products, props, and environments. Combine digital sculpting, polygonal modeling, and procedural tools to move freely from early concepts to production-ready 3D models.

Shape the mood, tone, and visual identity of every shot. Correct exposure and color, emulate film stocks, refine skin tones, reduce noise, and apply customizable cinematic looks directly in your editing timeline.

Combine footage, 3D renders, keyed subjects, and effects into one convincing image. Handle keying, tracking, light wrap, lens effects, shadows, reflections, and atmosphere without disrupting your existing workflow.

Turn real performances into animation-ready data using the iPhone you already have. Capture facial expressions and full-body movement, scan real-world objects, and transfer everything into Cinema 4D for faster, more natural animation.

Animate text, shapes, 3D objects, and visual systems for broadcast, advertising, film, and digital content. Build procedural animations that adapt quickly to revisions, render at GPU speed, and finish your work with integrated compositing and effects.

Transform raw footage into polished stories without leaving your preferred editing software. Add cinematic color, intelligent transitions, titles, particles, glows, distortions, and stylized effects directly in your timeline.

Create convincing effects from 3D asset creation and simulation through rendering, compositing, and color finishing. Combine digital elements with live-action footage and deliver production-ready shots, even when source material and deadlines are less than ideal.

Getting Started with ZBrush: A Beginners Guide
What is Maxon One capable of?

Maxon One covers the full 3D, motion design, and filmmaking pipeline, letting you sculpt, model, texture, rig, animate, simulate, render, composite, and color grade inside one connected set of tools. Artists use it for characters, motion graphics, VFX, product and architectural visualization, and more.
How do I start a free trial?
Download the Maxon App to start your 14-day free trial of Maxon One. With the Maxon App you can install, use, or try all of our products. Learn more here.
What’s included in a Maxon One subscription?
Every Maxon application comes in the plan: Cinema 4D, ZBrush, Redshift, Red Giant, Universe, and Autograph, plus the Maxon Capsules asset library, Cineware, and Cineversity training.
Is Maxon One a good choice if I’m new to 3D?

Yes. You can start in whichever application fits your current work, then grow into the rest as projects demand without buying another license. Cineversity training is included to help you get productive in each tool.
I am a professional 3D artist. Is Maxon One a good choice for me?

Yes. Studios and independent professionals rely on these tools across film, VFX, games, broadcast, advertising, and design. Check out our customer stories for insight into how artists and studios run whole productions through Maxon One.
How much does Maxon One cost?

See current pricing for individual (one to four licenses) and team plans (more than four licenses). If you’re interested in volume and enterprise licensing, contact our sales team. For students, teachers, and institutions, education pricing is also available.
Can I use Maxon One on more than one computer?
Maxon One runs on one activated computer at a time, and the applications in the plan can’t be split across separate machines.
Which devices is Maxon One compatible with?

Maxon One is compatible with most of the latest versions of macOS and Windows, including Windows on Arm (WoA). ZBrush for iPad extends sculpting to iPad. For per-product detail, check out our list of system requirements.
